LABEL: GPIO0
WHY_AVOID: No boot sequence involvement; no USB or JTAG conflicts; freely assignable

LABEL: GPIO1
WHY_AVOID: No boot sequence involvement; no USB or JTAG conflicts; freely assignable

LABEL: GPIO3
WHY_AVOID: No flash/PSRAM connections; freely assignable without issues

LABEL: GPIO10
WHY_AVOID: No flash/PSRAM connections; freely assignable without issues

LABEL: GPIO2
WHY_AVOID: Must be held high during boot (if low on reset normal flash boot may fail)

LABEL: MTMS
WHY_AVOID: Used during boot; JTAG TMS for debugging; acts as Quad-SPI flash IO (hold data line) in internal-flash variants

LABEL: MTDI
WHY_AVOID: Used during boot; JTAG TDI for debugging; acts as Quad-SPI flash IO (write-protect data line) in internal-flash variants

LABEL: MTCK
WHY_AVOID: Used during boot; JTAG TCK for debugging; provides flash clock in internal-flash variants

LABEL: MTDO
WHY_AVOID: Used during boot; JTAG TDO for debugging; acts as Quad-SPI flash IO (data line) in internal-flash variants

LABEL: GPIO8
WHY_AVOID: Must be held high during reset (if low UART flashing/boot may not work)

LABEL: GPIO9
WHY_AVOID: Controls boot mode on reset (HIGH for normal flash boot LOW enters serial download mode)

LABEL: U0RXD
WHY_AVOID: Used as UART0 receive (console/bootloader); repurposing may disable serial programming and debug logs

LABEL: U0TXD
WHY_AVOID: Used as UART0 transmit (console/bootloader); repurposing may disable serial console output and printing
